name: French Developer Textpack
description: Self-contained French resources for ordinary document NLP; heavy corpus, parallel, and annotation datasets are acquired separately.

publishabilityEvidence.productionGradeSourceCoverage: Self-contained French distribution with foundation, core, normalization, segmentation, Lexique and UniMorph lexicon/morphology, Wikidata KB, search, and quality resources.
publishabilityEvidence.auditedLicense: Selected IANA, Unicode, CLDR, Wikidata, Tatoeba-derived profile evidence, Lexique, and UniMorph sources are approved and retain generated attribution and license evidence in this honestly share-alike distribution.
publishabilityEvidence.declaredScope: Ordinary typed-French document NLP. Large corpora, parallel alignments, and UD annotation datasets are deliberately excluded from the npm package and remain explicit forge acquisition inputs.
